notes: imd/acc on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663), first launch: one contract, the RemoteStacker, the Robinhood Chain end of imd/acc's multichain route. A project here calls the same credit(trader, imdAmount) as on Ethereum; the IMD (0x5f7b...7127, a standard LayerZero OFT, 6 shared decimals) waits in this contract per trader, and anyone flushes up to 50 recipients to Ethereum through IMD's own bridge as a send-and-call to the live StackReceiver 0x1999...3d10 (launch #1529), which deposits each amount into the sIMD vault (0x9efa...7247, named here only so it is refused as a trader) for its trader. The flusher pays the bridge fee in Robinhood Chain's gas token (quoteFlush) and earns a tip of 2% per 12 hours waited, at most 2%, taken only from the whole bridge steps that leave; dust stays waiting, untipped. The contract builds the executor options itself (lzReceive 250,000 gas; lzCompose 200,000 + 80,000 per recipient) and sends to endpoint id 30101. A smart-contract wallet is paid plain IMD here at once unless it names an Ethereum recipient with setEthereumRecipient; EIP-7702 delegations are plain wallets. Queued(project, trader, recipient, imd) is the points record on this chain. No owner, admin, pause or upgrade; nobody can withdraw, redirect or freeze anything; the constructor makes no external call. Test doubles under test/mocks and test/trial are not deployed.
